summary: Faz 9 CP4.28 — Task Lock Audit Log e2e verified. Backend: 8/8 new audit tests PASS + 13/13 lock regression PASS (21/21 total). Frontend: LockConfigModal now has KISITLAMALAR + TARİHÇE tabs; history panel calls GET /lock-audit, renders event rows with icon + Turkish label + actor (username+role) + tarih + payload summary; YENİLE refresh works; existing KISITLAMALAR flags/set-all/clear-all/save regression intact; task-lock-badge still visible on card.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /tasks/{tid}/lock-audit: limit=0 is coerced to 100 via `int(limit or 100)` (falsy). If intent was 'clamp low', use `max(1, min(int(limit), 500))` without the `or` fallback so limit=0 → 1. Non-blocking, works in practice.
TasksPanel.jsx keeps growing (>3200 lines with audit UI). Split into LockConfigModal / LockHistoryPanel modules recommended (repeat of last iteration's note).
_log_lock_event swallows all exceptions silently — for a KVKK trail this is risky. Log at least at WARN level so lost audit rows are observable.
task_lock_audit collection has no TTL/retention policy documented — for KVKK you may want an explicit retention window and an index on (task_id, created_at).
seed_data_creation: Dynamically created TEST_audit_* tasks via API in each test; all cleaned up. One UI-side seed task also created and deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Audit endpoint GET /api/tasks/{tid}/lock-audit?limit=N (default 100, clamp 1..500). Response {task_id, task_exists, count, rows:[{id,task_id,event_type,actor_user_id,actor_username,actor_role,created_at,payload}]} sorted DESC. Event types: lock_set, otp_issued, otp_verified, otp_consumed, otp_failed (payload.reason: wrong_or_used|malformed|expired|malformed_expiry), otp_invalidated, task_deleted. Admin bypass does NOT write otp_consumed. Deleted task audit only readable by admin. Frontend testids: lock-tab-config, lock-tab-history, lock-history-panel, lock-history-refresh. IMPORTANT: single-session auth kicks parallel logins → in pytest run with `-o addopts=''` to disable xdist parallelism.
